critical_code_review_comments: expense_adjustments.py: validations are tight — adjustment_amount>0, must be <= original expense amount, cumulative across siblings cannot exceed original, type must be one of 6 ADJUSTMENT_TYPES, expense_id existence checked against both `id` and legacy `expense_id` fields, all good.

_can_write() correctly broadens to is_super_admin/is_admin OR role_key in {admin,super_admin,accountant} OR roles.admin/accounting/accounts. FO (role_key=franchise_owner) correctly returns 403 on /create, /update, /delete.
_ensure_can_view() blocks non-admin from viewing other centers' adjustments via /list (verified test_08).
utils/adjustments.get_total_adjustments() — single source of truth, safe defaults, used by /summary and /monthly-report consistently.
Original expense row is never modified: tests verified amount is unchanged across create/update/delete and snapshot is taken from db.expenses only for audit fields on the adjustment doc.
/summary correctly wires total_adjustments + adjusted_expenses into financial_summary AND profitability formula uses adjusted_expenses (only for non-India centers; India returns None, intentional).
Zero-adjustment parity verified — after delete, total_adjustments=0 and adjusted_expenses == total_expenses, no behavioural drift vs prior release.
Pydantic models (CreateReq, UpdateReq, ListReq, ReportReq) provide input validation; clean error messages on validation failures.
Cumulative cap on UPDATE excludes the row being edited (siblings filter via $ne adjustment_id) — verified test_04 update path.
